play_store_on_s24_ultra.banner: Ứng dụng này chỉ dùng được trên các thiết bị khác của bạn
play_store_on_s24_ultra.meaning: Play Store marks S24 Ultra incompatible. Install is offered only to other Google-account devices.
play_store_on_s24_ultra.retry_button: Sends the app to Ss80x_64, not to the S24 Ultra. Network warning means that other device is offline.
play_store_on_s24_ultra.likely_cause: S24 Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 is 64-bit only; MooWii Play build last updated 2024-10-30 and is missing from the S24 device catalog (often 32-bit native libs).
play_store_on_s24_ultra.next_step: Ask Gace for arm64 APK / pgyer 6TIP. If sideload also fails NO_MATCHING_ABIS, this phone cannot run official MooWii.
